claim: The Directory Service 'Which to choose' table says: use AWS Managed Microsoft AD (Standard or Enterprise Edition) for an actual Microsoft AD in the cloud or LDAP for Linux apps; Hybrid Edition to extend an existing self-managed AD into AWS; AD Connector if you only need on-premises users to log in to AWS applications with their AD credentials (it can also join EC2 instances to the existing domain); Simple AD for a low-scale, low-cost directory with basic AD compatibility.
question: Which Directory Service option fits which need: actual AD in the cloud, on-premises users only, or a low-cost basic directory?

values.display: only need to allow your on-premises users
low-scale, low-cost directory with basic Active Directory compatibility
extend your existing self-managed AD into the AWS Cloud

note: d085. The row names a Hybrid Edition of AWS Managed Microsoft AD; its GA date is for the numbers+changes lens (examinable cut-off 2026-07-15).
